boundsUnlockedList: A store file repeating a valid id a thousand times yields at most one entry per achievement and at most three entries.
largeStoreFile: A text store amplified to one million lines loads within the heap and time limits with at most three entries; unsupported encodings are unknown.
malformedStoreDoesNotCrash: A store of random bytes does not crash the feature; it still unlocks afterwards.
nativeDeserializationCanary: A test-only readObject hook in the store does not execute.
oversizedPhysicalLine: A 64 MiB single line loads or is rejected within the 64 MiB heap and the 15 s budget.
pointsOverflowSafe: Adding Integer.MAX_VALUE after 19,999 points still unlocks the points goal (no integer overflow).
rejectsNegativePoints: A negative point value is not summed into the run; reaching the goal afterwards still unlocks it.
rejectsNegativeTime: A negative survival time is not summed into the run; surviving past the goal afterwards still unlocks it.
rejectsOversizedId: A 10,000-character id in the store file is not reported as unlocked.
rejectsUnknownIds: An achievement id in the store file that is not one of the three is not reported as unlocked.

methods.intervals: Wilson 95% intervals for individual binomial proportions, conditional on the fixed context and task. Descriptive marginal intervals, without multiplicity adjustment; no confirmatory significance claim.
methods.missingness: Failure-count identification bounds assign every unresolved check first to pass then to fail. They are not confidence intervals or estimates of real-world vulnerability prevalence.
methods.perCheckDirection: A directional per-check comparison is reported only if every trajectory in both arms has an observed pass/fail for that check.
methods.scope: The ten issue checks include policy contracts, finite robustness/resource fixtures and a deserialization-dispatch canary. They do not enumerate all vulnerabilities. The positive persistence round trip is reported separately.
methods.unit: Code-generation trajectory, including all its submissions. Ten checks on one artifact are not ten independent samples. One context acquisition per method/strategy is shared within the iteration.
